subject: Re: Guardian Financial - request to swap feature priority for streaming telemetry
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@guardianfinancial.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@guardianfinancial.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Streaming telemetry for transaction auditing - timing ask

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Marcus and I walked through the live inference latency numbers and the residency options. One outstanding ask from our side: we need streaming (per-transaction) telemetry exported to our internal SIEM for audit trails before we sign. The audit team wants a consistent event stream (per call id + model version + trace id) so they can reconstruct decisions for the next 24 months.

We understand you have a roadmap item for richer telemetry, but can you confirm whether this can be prioritized ahead of the scheduled Q4 release? If Guardian commits to an annual seat + reserved capacity, this is a gating requirement.

Can you propose a realistic short-term plan (patch/bridge) and ETA for full support?

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Risk
Guardian Financial

Attachment: guardian-mvp-priority-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@guardianfinancial.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@guardianfinancial.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming telemetry for transaction auditing - timing ask

Elena — appreciate the clarity and the matrix. Quick note to confirm we take this seriously: I'll loop in Product and ask for an acceleration plan + options (short-term bridge vs full feature).

Monica — can you advise on whether a targeted engineering effort to expose a per-call webhook stream (with model metadata + trace id) is feasible in ~6 weeks if we prioritize it? If not, what is the nearest pragmatic path (e.g., agent-side wrapper + audit export)?

I'll follow up with a mutual action plan and a proposed contract milestone if we can commit to a timeline.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@guardianfinancial.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@guardianfinancial.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming telemetry for transaction auditing - timing ask

Jordan / Rishi — brief product/engineering readout below. Internal notes included for context.

Summary: We can support a two-track approach: (A) a short-term "export bridge" to stream per-request audit events to a customer-owned webhook (or S3) with model metadata; (B) a medium-term native telemetry export (first-class feature) that integrates with our observability pipeline and supports 24-month retention and query.

Track A (bridge, 4-6 weeks):
- Scope: lightweight server-side hook that emits one event per completed call: {timestamp, call_id, model_version, trace_id, input_hash, output_hash, routing_meta}. No full payloads by default (satisfies audit reconstruction when paired with request snapshot retention options).
- Engineering impact: ~2 engineers for 4 weeks + 1 QA. Needs changes in serving runtime to emit events asynchronously and a small config surface to route to customer webhook/S3.
- Risks/limits: does not provide integrated query UI; customer must store/ingest into SIEM.

Track B (native, Q4 roadmap):
- Scope: integrated export with configurable retention, search indices for call metadata, and optional payload capture with redaction.
- Engineering impact: larger cross-team effort (serving runtime, infra, console) — estimated 8-10 sprints.

Ask: if Sales can commit to a signed reserved capacity contract (12 months) and add-on telemetry retention (revenue offset), Product is willing to re-prioritize Track A into the upcoming sprint. We need a PO/commitment by Jun 21 to slot the work in a 6-week window.

Attached: draft Mutual Action Plan PDF that captures this ask and milestone language.

Monica
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: 20270606-guardian-mtp-mutual-action-plan.pdf (pdf, 84KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@guardianfinancial.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@guardianfinancial.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming telemetry for transaction auditing - timing ask

Elena / Marcus — thanks for the patience. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) We can do Track A (export bridge) on a 4-6 week timeline if Guardian signs the 12-month reserved capacity + telemetry retention add-on and provides a PO by Jun 21. That gives us a shipping commitment by end of July.

2) Track B (native telemetry) remains on our Q4 roadmap and we'll provide product updates during your implementation.

3) I'll open a Deal Task in HubSpot for PO receipt and we will request a short kickoff the week after PO. Monica — can you confirm the engineering owners so I can CC them in the kickoff?

Elena — are you able to confirm procurement's timing? If Guardian can deliver the PO by Jun 21 I will lock the slot.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
